<MethodEndpoint
  method={"put"}
  path={"/organizations/{organizationId}/users/{userId}/activate"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



Activates deactivated credentials.

Their password, keys, home directory and network rules are unchanged, so they can connect again
immediately. Activating credentials that are already active changes nothing.
